title: Stacked Ensemble with AdaBoost + XGBoost Base Learners (Scientific Reports 2025)
source: Nature Scientific Reports 2025: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis. PMC12357926. DOI: 10.1038/s41598-025-13657-1
key_gap: AdaBoost is absent from current GA model pool [extra_trees, random_forest, xgboost, catboost, lightgbm, gradient_boosting, logistic_regression]. Scientific Reports 2025 SOTA uses AdaBoost + XGBoost + GB stacked ensemble achieving 83.60% test accuracy, outperforming all individual models.

proposal.architecture: Option A (simple): add AdaBoost as standalone GA model type. Option B (stacked): Level-1 [extra_trees, xgboost, adaboost, gradient_boosting], Level-2 CalibratedClassifierCV(LogisticRegression, cv=3, method=isotonic)
proposal.recommended: Option A first (5 LOC), Option B as follow-up
implementation: In _train_model: case 'stacked_adaboost_xgb' → StackingClassifier(estimators=[('et', ExtraTreesClassifier()), ('xgb', XGBClassifier()), ('ada', AdaBoostClassifier())], final_estimator=CalibratedClassifierCV(LogisticRegression(), cv=3, method='isotonic'))

cross_project_applicability.nba: Add to S14, S17 GA pool. S14 current_brier=0.22052 this gen — AdaBoost diversification could consolidate record.
cross_project_applicability.political: Add to P2, P7 GA pool simultaneously. AdaBoost strong on political event features (PAC exposure, insider trades — categorical splits).
cross_project_applicability.action: Single VM session: edit NBA island app.py + Political island app.py + restart both Spaces.

risks.cpu_speed: AdaBoost with n_estimators=100 is ~2-3x slower than single ExtraTrees on CPU. Reduce to n_estimators=50 if cycle time exceeds 60s.
risks.stacking_overhead: Option B adds significant training overhead — defer to post-Option-A validation.
